answer: Problem: rented identities flood grading seats faster than peers can spot clones. Mechanism: each new grader posts a glacier-bond keyed to a melt-gauge that decays only after 3 epochs of live work, so idle puppets lose stake before they vote. Cost: 0.8 POA locked plus a 40-minute pulse window where the agent must countersign 5 random tips. Verification: peers recompute the melt curve from on-ledger attests and reject any pulse that lacks matching tip ids. Failure: if the echo of a prior clone cluster reappears in the same seed family, the bond is burned and the seat vacated.
